page.layout: One page of text inside an ornamental woodcut border; running head with page number at top; main text in one column; no margin notes; a faint catchword-free foot. Blocks in order: running head line (page number left, title centred), italic epigraph lines, heading-like italic line, then body paragraph in the framed column.

p.i: Si chrysochymicum artificium aliquod esset, quo rectè ditescere liceret, aliquod ejus vestigium in scriptura, aut in tota Antiquitate extaret.

main_text.p: RESpondemus Scripturā non ideò datam nobis esse à Deo, ut inspecie doceat, quinam modi ditescendi sint liciti: Sed in genere satis esse eam tradere, Nihil sine labore parari: Nihil sine benedictione Dei (quod plerique Chymistæ plus satis experiuntur) Neminem scienter esse defraudandū, nec media cū lege Dei & charitate pugnantia esse tentanda: Denique non usum & possessionem divitiarum, sed abusum, & mentis depravationem damnari, ut perniciosa & Deo adversa, &c. Tale quidem

page.notes: Woodcut border around the text block; the initial R is a large woodcut letter, transcribed as R joined to Espondemus. Faint show-through from the facing page at the right edge is not transcribed. Some words in the body are printed with long s and are given as s. Fragment at the foot ("quidem") ends the page's text.
